header: TELLING THE HOME PAGE THAT THE ANNOUNCEMENTS CHANGED. The lists of announcements on the home page (src/components/AnnouncementsFeed.tsx and src/components/Announcements.tsx) keep what they fetched in the SWR cache and ask again only when the window gets focus again, so an announcement published, edited or deleted in the Announcement Manager (which is inside the search window, on the same page) did not show until the browser was refreshed. I make the manager call refreshAnnouncements() after every change that succeeded; every list that holds the announcements then fetches again at once.

symbols.name: isAnnouncementListKey
doc: The SWR keys of the announcement lists: "/api/announcements" and "/api/announcements?u=<user>". I leave out the file, read and single-announcement routes, because those are not lists.

symbols.name: refreshAnnouncements
doc: I make every announcement list on the page fetch its data again.

behaviours: the two lists' keys match: /api/announcements (the side list) and /api/announcements?u=<user> (the feed), for any user
nothing that is not a list matches: the file, read and single-announcement routes, other APIs, and keys that are not text
the manager refreshes the lists after a publish, an edit and a delete that succeeded (three calls, each inside its success branch), and imports the helper
the helper's keys are the ones the two lists really use
asking for a refresh when no list is on the page does no harm (it answers, with nothing to refresh)
